description: Override what the app sees when it asks for a permission, without changing the OS. set makes `permission` read as `state` (undetermined = not asked, granted, limited = approximate location / selected photos or contacts / provisional notifications, denied, blocked = Android 'don't ask again', restricted = iOS parental controls); iOS has no blocked (a refusal is final, so denied reads as blocked) and Android has no restricted. clear returns one permission to the OS answer, reset clears all. While overridden, the real system prompt never shows: a request from undetermined (or Android denied) is answered by `answer` (ask = Buoy shows a prompt on the device and waits for a tap; allow, limited or deny answer at once) and moves the state the way the OS would. Linking.openSettings and app-settings: open Buoy's stand-in for Settings. By default a change sends the app background → active, like a return from Settings, so screens that re-check on foreground update; permission hooks that read only on mount update on their next read. With enforce on (default), calls that need access (current position, launch camera, media library reads) fail with the native module's error while refused. request_real shows the real system prompt once so the OS grants what the override pretends. The override survives reload_app.

answer.description: answer (required): how a request from 'not asked' is answered while overridden.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

enforce.description: settings: fail calls that need a refused permission. Default on.

interceptSettings.description: settings: stand in for Settings while overridden. Default on.

notifyApp.description: settings: send background → active after each change. Default on.

permission.description: set / clear / request_real (required): location, locationBackground, camera, microphone, notifications, photos, contacts, calendar, reminders, tracking, motion, bluetooth, or android:<android.permission.NAME>.

persist.description: settings: keep overrides across reloads. Default on.

showChip.description: settings: show the floating chip while overridden. Default on.

state.description: set (required): the state the app sees.

name: permission_action
